sections.heading: What is Record, Exclude, Extract, and NonNullable?

blocks.text: **Record, Exclude, Extract, and NonNullable** is a compile-time TypeScript concept that erases at emit — the run-time behavior is still JavaScript. Record, Exclude, Extract, and NonNullable enforces null safety at compile time in TypeScript and defensive patterns at run time in JavaScript. This section defines terms before code — read the glossary, then run the snippets in Node or the browser console.
